Production entry/SL/TP2 are frozen at episode start; after TP1 the remaining position is protected at breakeven for canonical paper-performance accounting; public provider chain; first 5m touch, 1m refinement for same-5m ambiguity; excursions stop at terminal first-touch; expired positions marked to market at 12h.
